llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create the root navigator with `createDrawerNavigator` from `@react-navigation/drawer`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createDrawerNavigator is imported from @react-navigation/drawer and called to create the Drawer navigator.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must register both `Account` and `Help` as drawer screen routes in the drawer navigator config.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both Account and Help are registered as Drawer.Screen children inside Drawer.Navigator.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must build navigation from the drawer tree via `createStaticNavigation(...)` and render that navigation component from `App`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createStaticNavigation is called with no arguments and its result is only used as a ref source; the returned static navigation component is never rendered. Instead the app renders NavigationContainer with dynamic JSX children, which is the dynamic API pattern, not the static API pattern.
evidence: App returns NavigationContainer wrapping Drawer.Navigator JSX, not the component returned by createStaticNavigation

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The static API requires passing the root navigator config (e.g. createDrawerNavigator({screens:{...}})) to createStaticNavigation and rendering the result. Instead, createStaticNavigation() is called with no arguments and the dynamic NavigationContainer + JSX tree pattern is used.
evidence: No navigator config object passed to createStaticNavigation
NavigationContainer with JSX children is rendered instead of the static navigation component
